acceptance_criteria.criterion: domSelectRequireFirst() throws DOMSelectorException (not the plain base exception)
The thrown exception message is still 'Selector [%s] not found.' (for backward compatibility)
DOMSelectorException::getSelector() on the thrown exception returns the selector that was searched
DOMSelectorException::getHTML() on the thrown exception returns the HTML held by DOMHelper at throw time
All existing unit tests still pass

summary: Replaced throw new WebcomicsBuilderException(...) with throw new DOMSelectorException($selector, $this->html, sprintf(...)) in domSelectRequireFirst().
All 4 existing unit tests pass after composer dump-autoload.

comments.note: The existing throw in domSelectRequireFirst() passed two string arguments (message + details) and a code constant to WebcomicsBuilderException. DOMSelectorException only forwards message, code and previous to parent. The 'details' string and ERROR_CANNOT_FIND_NODE code are lost. This is acceptable per the WP spec, but callers that relied on the code constant will no longer see it.
